description: Exact 3x3 range-bucket × category count matrix over the same synthetic corpus.
instruction:
The file corpus.jsonl in this directory has 400 rows of JSONL. Each line is one JSON object with fields id (synthetic token r000–r399), name (a 3–6 character non-English token), value (integer 1–999), and category (a single letter A–F). Scan the whole file; answers are not stored anywhere else.

Build the 3x3 count matrix of (range bucket × category).
Value range buckets (inclusive):
- b0: value in [1, 203]
- b1: value in [204, 358]
- b2: value in [359, 999]
Category columns, in this order: B, C, E.
Each cell is the number of rows whose value falls in that bucket AND whose category is that column. Rows whose category is not one of those three letters do not appear in the matrix.
Write a JSON object to answers.json at the workspace root:
{"matrix": [[n00, n01, n02], [n10, n11, n12], [n20, n21, n22]]}
Rows are b0, b1, b2. Columns follow the category order B, C, E. Integers only. No extra keys.
